CITY OF SAN MARINO

  LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES AGENDA

Kathy Osegueda, Chair  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Debra Sadun, Vice Chair  (626) 300-0777 Phone

Genevieve Chien, Trustee  Crowell Public Library

Steve Domier, Trustee  1890 Huntington Drive
Vivi Wahl, Trustee  San Marino, CA 91108

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, MARCH 24, 2025 AT 8:00 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Library
Board of Trustees with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Monday of every month at 8:00 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
KShigenaga@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300-0791 prior to the meeting for
assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom.

How to offer public comment from home:

  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to KShigenaga@SanMarinoCA.gov until
  7:00 a.m. the day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 7:00 a.m.
  will be distributed to the Library Board of Trustees during the meeting. Any

AGENDA – MARCH 24, 2025  PAGE 1 of 3
   comments received after 7:00 a.m. will be included in the public comment record
  but not provided to the Library Board of Trustees at the meeting.
  2. Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be
  accepted after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Peck, Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Domier, Trustee Wahl, Vice Chair
Sadun, Chair Osegueda

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington
Drive, and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is
also posted on the City’s website: http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up
on such items.

  BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

 1.  CHAIRPERSON REPORT

 2.  TRUSTEE REPORTS

 3.  CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

 4.  FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT

 5.  SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT

AGENDA – MARCH 24, 2025  PAGE 2 of 3
   NEW BUSINESS

 6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Board approve the minutes of the special
  meeting of February 24, 2025. If the Board concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of February 24, 2025.”

 7.  DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Board receive and file the Director and
  Library Manager Report. If the Board concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Director and Library Manager Report.”

 8.  QUARTERLY OPERATIONAL UPDATE FROM THE SAN MARINO PUBLIC
  LIBRARY FOUNDATION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Board receive the Quarterly Operational
  Update from the San Marino Public Library Foundation. If the Board concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive the Quarterly Operational Update from the San Marino Public
  Library Foundation.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the Library Board of Trustees. All public writings distributed by the
City of San Marino to at least a majority of the Library Board of Trustees regarding any item
on this agenda will be made available at the Crowell Public Library located at 1890
Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public
agenda packet that will available for review at the Library Board of Trustees meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: March 20, 2025  CATHI JOHNSON
  COMMUNITY SERVICES DIRECTOR
